info.title: SiteTrack API
info.description: Every route except register, login and refresh needs `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Errors always look like `{ "error": "code", "message": "text" }`. Anything inside a project you are not a member of answers 404, the same as a project that does not exist.

post.summary: Register a new account and log in
Log in with email and password
post.description: A wrong email and a wrong password give the same 401 answer.

post.summary: Swap a refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token
post.description: Access tokens last 15 minutes. Each refresh token works once and keeps the session alive for 30 more days.

post.summary: End the current session

get.summary: My profile and unread notification count
Projects screen: every project I can access
get.description: Search matches the name or the ID (PRJ-0042, 0042 or 42). Blocked counts are worked out for the returned page only.

post.summary: Create a project; I become its project admin

delete.description: Refused with 409 while the project store holds stock or a delivery is in transit, so no material disappears.

get.summary: Members screen: members (admins first) and invitations not yet answered

post.summary: Invite a registered user by email (project admins)

delete.summary: Withdraw an invitation that has not been answered (project admins)

patch.summary: Make a member a project admin, or take admin away (project admins)
patch.description: Taking admin from the last project admin is refused with 409.

delete.summary: Remove a member (project admins), or leave the project yourself
delete.description: Removing the last project admin is refused with 409. The removed person loses access on their next request.

get.summary: My notifications (project invitations), newest first, with the unread count
Unread notification count, for the badge on every page

post.summary: Mark notifications as read: send { "ids": [...] } for some, or {} for all of them
Accept my invitation and join the project
post.description: Only the invited person can answer. Anyone else gets 404.

post.summary: Reject my invitation
post.description: Only the invited person can answer. Anyone else gets 404.

get.description: from/to keep tasks whose planned period overlaps that range. q matches the name or the ID (PRJ-0042-T-0137, T-0137 or 137).

post.summary: Create a task; it starts as not_started

get.summary: Task details: allowed actions plus every task it waits on and that waits on it, with step counts

patch.summary: Edit a task name or dates (status changes go through the action routes)

delete.summary: Remove a task and its dependency links. Its ID is never handed out again.

post.summary: Start: not_started to in_progress, only when every task it waits on is done
Mark as done: in_progress to done
Reopen: done to in_progress, only while no task that waits on it has started
Make this task wait on another task in the same project
post.description: Rejected with 409 when it would make a task wait on itself, directly or through other tasks.

delete.summary: Stop this task waiting on another task

get.summary: Materials catalogue (everyone logged in), sorted by name

post.summary: Add a material to the catalogue (company store managers and SuperAdmins)

get.summary: Every category in use, for filter dropdowns

patch.summary: Edit a material (company store managers and SuperAdmins)

delete.summary: Remove a material (company store managers and SuperAdmins)
delete.description: Refused with 409 once the material has any stock or delivery history.

get.summary: Company store stock screen (company store managers and SuperAdmins)
get.description: Status: out_of_stock when quantity is 0, low_stock when at or below the reorder point, otherwise available. Sorting by status puts out_of_stock first.

post.summary: Add stock that arrived from a supplier (company store managers and SuperAdmins)

patch.summary: Set the reorder point for a material (company store managers and SuperAdmins)

get.summary: Project store screen: every material the store has held
Company store deliveries screen, newest first (company store managers and SuperAdmins)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: sent on or after this day

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: sent on or before this day

post.summary: Send materials from the company store to a project store (company store managers and SuperAdmins)
post.description: The quantities leave company stock at once and the delivery is in_transit. 409 insufficient_stock when any line is short; nothing moves then.

get.summary: Project picker for the company store: ID and name of every project (company store managers and SuperAdmins)
Project deliveries screen: incoming and outgoing, newest first

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: sent on or after this day

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: sent on or before this day

post.summary: Send materials from this project store back to the company store (project members)
post.description: Project stores never deliver to each other; the receiver is always the company store.

post.summary: Record an arrived delivery: the quantities join the receiving store
post.description: The receiver of a to_project delivery is the project (any member); of a to_company delivery, the company store. The sender is the other side. 409 when the delivery is no longer in transit.

post.summary: Reject an arrived delivery: the quantities go back to the sender
post.description: The receiver of a to_project delivery is the project (any member); of a to_company delivery, the company store. The sender is the other side. 409 when the delivery is no longer in transit.

post.summary: Cancel a delivery still in transit: the quantities go back to the sender
post.description: The receiver of a to_project delivery is the project (any member); of a to_company delivery, the company store. The sender is the other side. 409 when the delivery is no longer in transit.
